captions.detailed: This 3D model features a compact folding-bike crankset assembly, consisting of a central black bottom bracket spindle, a single black-toothed chainring with five metallic spider arms, and two silver-grey crank arms pointing in opposite directions. At the end of each crank arm, a black rectangular pedal is mounted via a hinge joint. The pedals are designed to fold 90 degrees inward toward the crank arms to achieve a highly compact profile for storage.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a compact folding-bike crankset using Python and CadQuery. The model should include a central bottom bracket spindle, a single small-diameter black chainring with five spider arms, two silver-grey crank arms, and two folding black pedals that can articulate 90 degrees inward on knuckle joints.
captions.factory: The code constructs the crankset assembly by first modeling the central bottom bracket spindle using a Cylinder primitive. Next, a single chainring is created using a combination of a Cylinder for the base disk, a series of subtracted polar-patterned wedges for the teeth, and five rectangular extrusions for the spider arms. The crank arms are built with Box and Cylinder shapes, positioned at 180-degree offsets. Finally, the folding pedals are created as hollow rectangular frames with hinge knuckles, connected to the crank arms via revolute joint definitions that allow them to fold flat.
